## Fortes (2019), 300 K BM4 slice

**untested** (not refittable) · `lead_fcc_fortes_2019_bm4_1` · `BM4` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/lead_fcc.md#record-lead_fcc_fortes_2019_bm4_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The published pressure surface is executable and three exact Kuznetsov fcc transition P-V-T anchors are bundled, but the compiled coefficient fit cannot be independently reproduced. The full 295-788 K Kuznetsov table was supplied privately to Fortes, while the exhaustive source-row selection, pressure-scale treatment, residual coordinate, weights, and covariance procedure are not published. See the \[dedicated Fortes audit\](literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** lead\_fcc\_kuznetsov\_2002\_table1\_transition\_pvt
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; K0

### More evidence

- [Supporting source report: fortes-2019-fcc-pb](../literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).

## Kuznetsov et al. (2002), 296 K BM3 slice

**untested** (not refittable) · `lead_fcc_kuznetsov_2002_bm3_2` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/lead_fcc.md#record-lead_fcc_kuznetsov_2002_bm3_2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The three bundled Table 1 rows are rounded fcc states at the phase transition, not the complete P-V-T observations used to fit the source's nine-coefficient thermal BM3 surface. The full numerical dataset, row selection, residual coordinate, weights, and covariance procedure are not published. See the \[dedicated Fortes/Kuznetsov audit\](literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** lead\_fcc\_kuznetsov\_2002\_table1\_transition\_pvt

### More evidence

- [Supporting source report: fortes-2019-fcc-pb](../literature-reproductions/fortes-2019-fcc-pb.md).
